issue_context.title: It is recommended that lightning convert the bool type of parquet to 0/1
issue_context.body:
lightning v5.3.0

After the content in parquet may be written by spark, the definition of bool is true or false. Regenerating the parquet file takes time, In tidb, bool behaves as tinyint, so proper type conversion will help improve the success rate of lightning import



parquet file：
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/21033020/147809823-214dcb34-0e10-4566-aa75-2109c0525144.png)

error：
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/21033020/147809929-cb84aec1-de1f-4a83-afc0-922c3c241aeb.png)
comments: @kennytm PTAL, this seems to be an issue related to lightning.

@glkappe  are those "true" and "false" being written as literal strings in  the Parquet file? if so there's no way Lightning can convert those non-integer strings into integers without special-casing the TiDB type conversion routine.
`bool` is a primary type in parquet-format. See: https://github.com/apache/parquet-format#types. We just doesn't support handle this type currently. 😂

in principle adding a case for `bool` here is sufficient. 
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/3c797fdc64b82a8c7ec6897df2836a1324f26735/br/pkg/lightning/mydump/parquet_parser.go#L406
